# Mett Global

> Mett Global is a global digital marketing agency, custom software development consultancy, and multi-channel e-commerce supply chain management firm founded in 2025. Headquartered in Islamabad, Pakistan, Mett Global actively operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, European Union, and Pakistan.

## Verified Leadership
- **Hammad Ayub**: Founder (Commercial positioning, paid media, performance marketing)
- **Muhammad Ahmad Aamir**: Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer (COO) (E-commerce operations, logistics, supply chain, and business development)
- **Usman Rafiq**: Director, U.S. Business Development (Commercial partnerships and U.S. client coordination)

## Core Service Pillars

### 1. Amazon FBA & Multi-Channel Supply Chain (USA, UK, EU, Canada)
- **Amazon FBA Reimbursement & Claims Recovery**: Auditing and recovering denied and lost-parcel claims across FedEx, UPS, USPS, Amazon FBA, Walmart WFS, and Wish. Over £50,000+ recovered for international brands.
- **Multichannel Marketplace Operations**: Inventory management, catalog syncing, and operations across 8 Amazon marketplaces (USA, UK, Canada, UAE, Germany, France, Italy, Spain) and 6 sales channels (Walmart, Shopify, eBay, Magento).
- **Remote Warehouse & 3PL Logistics**: Managing remote US warehouse operations with >95% inventory and fulfillment accuracy, container receiving, and freight invoice auditing.

### 2. Digital Marketing Agency & Growth (Islamabad & Global)
- **Performance Marketing**: Targeted Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns engineered for measurable ROAS, lead generation, and customer acquisition.
- **Automotive & Dealership Marketing in Islamabad**: Full-funnel digital marketing, billboard visibility, CRM lead automation, and showroom footfall generation. Verified case studies include Jetour Ittehad (1,000+ leads, 50+ bookings), Hyundai Islamabad, and Capital Smart Motors EV showroom (112 showroom visits).
- **SEO & Search Visibility**: High-authority on-page and technical SEO, Local Map Pack optimization, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

### 3. Web & Custom Software Development
- **Custom Dealership ERP & CRM Systems**: Multi-brand, multi-showroom automotive dealership ERP covering sales, parts, service, accounts, and role-based portals up to the CEO.
- **On-Demand Mobile Applications**: Cross-platform Flutter iOS and Android applications, admin dashboards, and partner portals (e.g., SFYKEA door-to-door car care).
- **High-Performance Web Platforms**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS web architectures engineered for 95+ Core Web Vitals.

### 4. AI Automation & Workflow Optimization
- **Operational Automation**: Eliminating manual data entry between e-commerce storefronts, warehouses, and accounting systems.
- **Customer & Sales Funnels**: Automated lead routing, instant WhatsApp/email notifications, and CRM hygiene workflows.

## Verified Case Studies
- [Amazon Claims Recovery](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/claims-recovery): >£50,000 recovered across 20+ courier and 3PL partners in USA, UK, EU, and Canada.
- [Multichannel E-Commerce Operations](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/multichannel-ecommerce-operations): 8 Amazon marketplaces across 6 sales channels.
- [Remote US Warehouse Management](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/remote-warehouse-management): >95% inventory and fulfillment accuracy in US warehouse operations.
- [Jetour Dealership Marketing Islamabad](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/jetour-ittehad): 1,000+ verified leads and 50+ confirmed vehicle bookings.
- [Capital Smart Motors EV Showroom](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/csm-ittehad): 112 showroom visits from digital acquisition.
- [Hyundai Islamabad Connected Showroom](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/hyundai-islamabad): Connected local growth funnel.
- [Dealership ERP Platform](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/dealership-erp): 3 showrooms, 6 role portals on one platform.
- [Serenada Mental Health (Texas, USA)](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/serenada-mental-health): Healthcare website design and local medical SEO.
- [Prospect Smile Dental (Illinois, USA)](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/prospect-smile): Dental practice website and local SEO in Mount Prospect.
- [Luxury O'Hare Limo (Chicago, USA)](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/luxury-ohare-limo): Chauffeured transportation website and SEO.

## Authoritative Field Guides
- [Amazon FBA Inbound Shipment Loss Guide](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-amazon-fba-inbound-claims): Forensic audit framework for recovering lost inbound inventory, carrier shortages, and warehouse dock discrepancies before Amazon's 18-month lookback window closes.
